evidence.quote: After orientation, I require zero mandatory observatory days.
Editors may work fully remotely after initial orientation.
Editors attend the observatory in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Location arrangements remain flexible and should be discussed with the team.

assessments.rationale: One notice allows full remote work, another requires Tuesday and Thursday attendance, and the newer flexibility note does not resolve which rule governs this role.

conclusion.text: The location condition cannot be settled from these unsuperseded notices.
conclusion.next_step: Ask for the current role-specific attendance requirement and whether it replaces the earlier notices.

limitations: The latest date by itself does not make the flexible note authoritative over the other terms.
